segments.text: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain,

segments.speaker: Eve
segments.text: and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.

footnotes.text: + Cain: that is, Gotten, or, Acquired

segments.text: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.

footnotes.text: + in process…: Heb. at the end of days

segments.text: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
And the LORD said unto Cain,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.

footnotes.text: + be accepted: or, have the excellency

segments.text: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
¶ And the LORD said unto Cain,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Where is Abel thy brother?
And he said,

segments.speaker: Cain
segments.text: I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?
And he said,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand;

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
And Cain said unto the LORD,

segments.speaker: Cain
segments.text: My punishment is greater than I can bear.

footnotes.text: + My…: or, Mine iniquity is greater than that it may be forgiven

segments.speaker: Cain
segments.text: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.
And the LORD said unto him,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold.
And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
¶ And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
¶ And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
And his brother’s name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
And Lamech said unto his wives,

segments.speaker: Lamech
segments.text: Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

footnotes.text: + I have…: or, I would slay a man in my wound, etc.
+ to my hurt: or, in my hurt

segments.speaker: Lamech
segments.text: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
¶ And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth:

segments.speaker: Eve
segments.text: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

footnotes.text: + Seth: Heb. Sheth: that is Appointed, or, Put

segments.text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.

footnotes.text: + to call…: or, to call themselves by the name of the Lord
